clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Valley, Deputy Willem gathers red bandanas from slain Defias thieves near the abbey vineyards. The cloth marks low-ranking highwaymen and cutpurses of the Brotherhood.

Red burlap masks mark the Defias Brotherhood's rank-and-file. Cheap, rough cloth dyed red hides a thief's features and signals allegiance to the growing rebellion. In Northshire, young recruits and common thugs carry these scarves into the eastern orchards. The local guards recognize the striking red fabric as proof of thieves slain nearby.
